reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view of retail igi.exe (entry 0x004A50F5) and Radare2 6.2.0; the retail bytes were read directly and the candidate translation unit was read at its recorded digest.
source_revision: worktree branch 3a26bb23; implementation bound by engine/src/retail/core/app_context.cpp sha256 b6ba8b5b6d1e337910c59bc20ee7a50299013b9b50cbf14f7e0f235aa0037823
review_basis: The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja MCP view and independently recovered with Radare2; both graphs are recorded in the referenced evidence files and agree on nodes and edges. The candidate body was then compared against the retail instructions and the recorded retail bytes.

retail_function.name: App_ContextGetLightmapsUsed
retail_function.summary: App_ContextGetLightmapsUsed(): returns the 32-bit lightmaps-used field of the port app-context state, written by App_ContextSetLightmapsUsed (0x0048F240).

candidate_function.summary: App_ContextGetLightmapsUsed(): returns the 32-bit lightmaps-used field of the port app-context state, written by App_ContextSetLightmapsUsed (0x0048F240).

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail takes no arguments (cdecl, nargs=0) and returns the 32-bit flag in EAX. The candidate takes no arguments, returns the same 32-bit field from the port state and preserves cdecl.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Binary Ninja (live MCP view of retail igi.exe) and Radare2 6.2.0 both recover the exact entry 0x0048F230 as one 6-byte basic block with 0 edges (CFG node/edge sets identical, recorded score 1.000); the candidate defines App_ContextGetLightmapsUsed as the body implementing that entry.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail is cdecl with no stack arguments (Radare2 nargs=0). The candidate takes no arguments and preserves cdecl; there is no argument slot to mis-map.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: The only constant is the retail global address 0x005C8BE4, mapped to the named port field app_context_state.lightmaps_used. There is no scaling, size or derived constant in the 6-byte body or in the candidate.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Retail bytes a1 e4 8b 5c 00 c3 are `mov eax, dword [0x5c8be4]; retn`: a 32-bit load from the lightmaps-used flag. The candidate performs a 32-bit load of the same field in port-owned storage. The absolute address is relocated by the port; the access width, access kind and value flow are preserved.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: The retail body contains no call and no store: its only effect is the EAX result. The candidate likewise calls nothing and stores nothing. The matching store side of this flag lives in the setter 0x0048F240, not here.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: One return path: EAX is the 32-bit flag. The candidate returns the same field with no branch and no error path; neither body can fail.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Neither the 6-byte retail body nor the candidate contains an x87 instruction or any floating-point value.
